IN REPLY PLEASE REFER TO
Environmental Statement Randolph Urban Renewal Area
Mr. Theodore R. Robb Regional Administrator Department of Housing and Urban Development Curtis Building 6th and Walnut Street Philadelphia, Pennsylvania 19106
Dear Mr. Robb:
Reference is made to your letter of March 2, 1973. The Environmental Statement prepared by the Department of Housing and Urban Development has been reviewed by the Department of Highways; from our Urban Division review, we see no conflict with the Environmental Statement and have no comments.
We thank you for the opportunity of commenting on this statement.
Sincerely,
Environmental Quality Engineer
